name: Captain Shatterskull
summary: At Mor'shan Base Camp, Captain Shatterskull directs the Horde's defense of its northern border. A seasoned orc commander, he organizes the fight against night elf forces near Warsong Gulch.

sections.title: Guardian of the Northern Border
sections.body: At Mor'shan Base Camp, Captain Shatterskull guards the Horde's foothold on the edge of Ashenvale. He works with fellow officers such as Kadrak against night elf sentinels and Silverwing forces seeking to reclaim the borderlands. The struggle over Ashenvale's timber and ancient lands keeps the Barrens frontier under constant threat.

faq.answer: At Mor'shan Base Camp, Captain Shatterskull commands the Horde's defense against night elf forces. He is a seasoned orc commander.

faq.q: Where can Captain Shatterskull be found?
faq.answer: You can find Captain Shatterskull at Mor'shan Base Camp on the northern edge of the Barrens, before Ashenvale.

faq.q: What is his role at Mor'shan Base Camp?
faq.answer: At Mor'shan Base Camp, Captain Shatterskull commands the defense of the Horde's northern frontier. He rallies warriors against the Alliance's Silverwing Sentinels.

faq.q: Who does Captain Shatterskull work with?
faq.answer: Captain Shatterskull works alongside frontline officers such as Kadrak. Together, they coordinate defense and recruitment for border skirmishes.

angles.text: For Horde warriors coming from the southern Barrens, Captain Shatterskull guards the northern frontier against night elf incursions from Ashenvale.
As an orc, you may see Captain Shatterskull's defense of the Horde's hard-won lands as a reflection of your people's martial spirit. Others view orcs as invaders.
